decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer and has stayed on the website through 2024, which suggests results meet aspirations, and a large firm in a growing industry has the slack to carry it.

The cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration business and remains listed, so there is no visible shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, and slack allows continued support.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying portfolio for metalworking customers, so performance is likely satisfactory and dropping them would weaken the established offer.

Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core standard product close to the established business and are still marketed, which indicates results meet aspirations, so the firm has little reason to drop them, unlike the removed nozzles and magnetic conveyor.
